title: approval.granted
description: A human approved a gated action, or the action's autonomy level never required approval in the first place (core/approvals.py::request_approval()'s auto-grant path, decided_by='system:auto'). Emitted by core/approvals.py::resolve() or request_approval(). Consumed by the router -> JobSpec('sales.resume_gated_action') (orchestrator/router.py, M0.3 — the Sales agent that claims this job is M1.4, not built).

decided_by.description: 'human:<slack_user_id_or_name>' for a real decision, or 'system:auto' when the autonomy level didn't require approval.

token.description: The approval's stored capability token (approvals.token). Not currently required by is_approved() — approval_id alone gates — but generated and stored on every approval so tightening the gate to require it later is a one-line change, not a migration.
